newsitem.title: USA: Miami commissioner to plead guilty - TV report.
newsitem.headline: Miami commissioner to plead guilty - TV report.

text.p: Former Miami City Commissioner Miller Dawkins was scheduled to appear before a federal judge Wednesday to plead guilty to allegations he solicited a bribe in connection with a city computer contract, Miami television station WPLG reported.
The TV station said the guilty plea was part of an agreement with prosecutors, and that Dawkins would cooperate with their investigation of public finance corruption in Miami.
Federal prosecutors could not immediately be reached for comment.

Dawkins, former Miami City Manager, and lobbyist Jorge Luis de Cardenas were charged last month in an alleged conspiracy involving bribes and kickbacks for city contracts. Prosecutors said former Miami Finance Director Manohar Surana had agreed to plead guilty and was cooperating in the investigation.
The prosecutors are also investigating allegations of corruption in Dade County bond deals, according to subpoenas they have filed and county officials they have questioned.
